towns.name: Zaikhal
towns.summary: Zaikhal (13.7N 0.6E) is the capital of the Gharu'ndim, set among the hills at the northern edge of their realm - country like the Taban mountains of Gharu'n on Ispar. It was the original headquarters of the Arcanum and is still a centre of study: the great Gharu'ndim library (with the translator of Dericostian runes and the scholar of the Virindi language), the Radiant Blood society stronghold and one of the three Arcanum Mana Forges at the south end of town. In the DAT the town sits on a broad plateau at z 124 above wooded valleys to the north (64-90) and east (72-90). A row of sandstone halls and the domed tavern line a plaza with a pool flanked by blue-flame lamps, two wells, the Nullified Statue of a Zharalim, the Life Stone and the Town Network portal under great shade trees; the domed library crowns the western hill (z 144). South on the open plateau two red-and-gold Radiant Blood banners frame the Stronghold and Gauntlet portals among red-eyed guardian figures; 300 m east stands the Gold Legion Keep, a four-storey Viamontian tower with a gold roof and Viamontian knights at its foot.
